notes.title: Fixed an Issue Causing Slow Performance or Failure to Launch
notes.notes:
We have just released a fix for an issue reported by multiple users on the community forums where the game would either become extremely slow or freeze on launch.

The cause of this issue was related to specific regional and language settings (e.g., French, Russian, Spanish) on users' devices. Differences in how certain characters like "," and "." are interpreted in these settings caused the game’s internal parser to malfunction, leading to the game freezing or crashing.

If you were experiencing this issue, please update the game to the latest version and check if the problem has been resolved. We truly appreciate your patience and cooperation.

We are continuing to monitor and address issues on the community forums. If you encounter any further problems, please let us know here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3005930/discussions/0/

We’re committed to making BatteryNote an enjoyable experience for everyone. Thank you for your support!

72studio

notes.title: SNS and Game Streaming Guidelines
notes.notes:
We warmly welcome SNS posts and game streaming of BatteryNote from those who have reviewed the following guidelines!

[h1]SNS and Game Streaming Guidelines[/h1]

1. Please include the following information in your video description or post:
[code]BatteryNote
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3005930/BatteryNote/
©72studio / room6
#BatteryNote
[/code]
2. The following actions are prohibited:

Content that severely damages the game’s image.
Use in overtly sexual content or content that violates public order and morality.
3. Please be mindful of spoilers, especially regarding key story elements, and add spoiler warnings when necessary.

4. If requested by 72studio / room6, please promptly take down any videos or articles.

5. 72studio / room6 makes no guarantees regarding the publication or distribution of videos or articles. We will not compensate for any damages or disputes with third parties arising from the use of this game.

[h2]Streaming Assets[/h2]
Download them from the link below and use them for your streams:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/153wzifHu2Jxi41hiGk5Rnyj0UHoFkVZ8

Please refrain from using these assets for fan creations, derivative works, or doujin activities. These materials are for backup use in streaming only.

[h2]Official Hashtag for SNS[/h2]
Please use [b]#BatteryNote[/b].

We’re looking forward to seeing all your wonderful streams and content!

notes.title: We’ve released a demo supporting multiple languages!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/41c39bc94eee8843cbfcc2c6ef3c81b7f1655a29.png[/img]

In the demo, you can enjoy conversations — and even punish — three unique and quirky robots.

The opening also reveals part of the main story, letting you experience the game’s atmosphere!
Each playthrough takes about 10 minutes, and you can enjoy multiple branching scenarios. 
We hope you’ll give it a try!

By the way, we’ll also be participating in Steam Next Fest starting next week!
[b]Don’t forget to add us to your wishlist![/b]
